elements.requirement: Section 209 of the Equality Act 2010 applies where the power to make an order or regulations under the Act is exercisable by the Welsh Ministers.
elements.quote: where the power to make an order or regulations under this Act is exercisable by the Welsh Ministers

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument containing, whether alone or with other provision, an order or regulations specified in subsection (3) is subject to the affirmative procedure.
elements.quote: A statutory instrument containing (whether alone or with other provision) an order or regulations mentioned in subsection (3) is subject to the affirmative procedure

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Welsh Ministers under section 2 regarding socio-economic inequalities are subject to the affirmative procedure.
elements.quote: regulations under section 2 (socio-economic inequalities)

elements.requirement: An order made by the Welsh Ministers under section 151 regarding the power to amend the list of public authorities for the purposes of the public sector equality duty is subject to the affirmative procedure.
elements.quote: an order under section 151 (power to amend list of public authorities for the purposes of the public sector equality duty)

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Welsh Ministers under section 153 or 154(2) regarding powers to impose specific duties for the public sector equality duty are subject to the affirmative procedure.
elements.quote: regulations under section 153 or 154(2) (public sector equality duty: powers to impose specific duties)

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Welsh Ministers under section 155(5) regarding the power to modify or remove specific duties for the public sector equality duty that amend an Act of Parliament or an Act or Measure of the National Assembly for Wales are subject to the affirmative procedure.
elements.quote: regulations under section 155(5) that amend an Act of Parliament or an Act or Measure of the National Assembly for Wales (public sector equality duty: power to modify or remove specific duties)

elements.requirement: Regulations made by the Welsh Ministers under paragraph 6, 6A, or 6F of Schedule 17 regarding tribunal procedure, case friends, and the capacity of parents and persons over compulsory school age are subject to the affirmative procedure.
elements.quote: regulations under paragraph 6, 6A or 6F of Schedule 17 (tribunal procedure, case friends and capacity of parents and persons over compulsory school age)

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument is not subject to the affirmative procedure merely because it contains an order under section 151 that provides for the omission of an entry where the authority concerned has ceased to exist.
elements.quote: the omission of an entry where the authority concerned has ceased to exist

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument is not subject to the affirmative procedure merely because it contains an order under section 151 that provides for the variation of an entry where the authority concerned has changed its name.
elements.quote: the variation of an entry where the authority concerned has changed its name

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument made by the Welsh Ministers under the Equality Act 2010 that is not subject to the affirmative procedure by virtue of subsection (2) is subject to the negative procedure.
elements.quote: A statutory instrument that is not subject to the affirmative procedure by virtue of subsection (2) is subject to the negative procedure

elements.requirement: An order or regulations contained in a statutory instrument subject to the affirmative procedure must not be made unless a draft of the instrument is laid before and approved by a resolution of the National Assembly for Wales.
elements.quote: must not be made unless a draft of the instrument is laid before and approved by a resolution of the National Assembly for Wales

elements.requirement: A statutory instrument subject to the negative procedure is subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of the National Assembly for Wales.
elements.quote: subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of the National Assembly for Wales
